Self-service, standalone download sets you can download and run.

::: {.callout-important}
Tools here ingest or produce assessment data — a map of where a tenant is weak.
Treat that data as **Controlled**: keep it in-boundary, share only with
authorized personnel, and do not publish raw findings. Remediation guidance is
**advisory** — apply changes only through your normal change-control process.
:::

## Federal Application-Aware Networking Series

The Federal AAN series has been consolidated from its original flat "Parts 1–11"
layout into a **seven-volume, 43-book** program spanning the network, identity,
data-platform, security-operations, governance, training, and implementation
architecture required for **FedRAMP Moderate** authorization under FedRAMP 20x
rules (mandatory January 1, 2027).

::: {.callout-important}
**Internal reference — not a public download.** The current series is marked
*INTERNAL — NOT FOR PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION (UNCLASSIFIED // FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY)*
and is maintained for authorized federal agency personnel. The earlier public,
sanitized excerpt set previously linked here has been retired. For authorized
access to the complete series kit, contact the UIAO program owner.
:::

### Series structure

| Volume | Theme | Books |
|---|---|---|
| **Vol 0** | Executive Summary & Program | 2 |
| **Vol I** | Foundation & Transport | 8 |
| **Vol II** | Data Platform | 4 |
| **Vol III** | Security Operations | 8 |
| **Vol IV** | Governance & Assurance | 7 |
| **Vol V** | Training & Certification | 5 |
| **Vol VI** | Implementation | 9 |
| **Total** | — | **43** |

Every book ships as Word (`.docx`) and PowerPoint (`.pptx`), bundled into a
single kit organized into one folder per volume. Distribution is via authorized
internal channels only — no public download is offered here.

## ScubaDrift

**Drift, exception-lifecycle, and continuous-monitoring gating on top of CISA
ScubaGear.** ScubaGear assesses a Microsoft 365 tenant against the CISA SCuBA
baselines; ScubaDrift adds the operational layer it leaves out — run-to-run
drift, risk-acceptance lifecycle, a continuous-monitoring gate, and remediation
**SLA aging** mapped to CISA BOD 25-01, NIST SP 800-137 (ISCM), NIST 800-53
CA-7, and FedRAMP ConMon. It stands on the sanctioned tool and never touches a
tenant — it reads ScubaGear's JSON output. Python 3.10+, zero runtime
dependencies.

| Download | Contents |
|---|---|
| [`scubadrift-latest.zip`](scubadrift-latest.zip) | Runnable package — source, 47-test suite, examples, figure sources, and `ScubaDrift-Documentation.docx` |
| [`ScubaDrift-Documentation.docx`](ScubaDrift-Documentation.docx) | The full documentation as a single Word document (also inside the zip) |

Quick start:

```bash
unzip scubadrift-latest.zip && cd scubadrift
pip install .            # or: pip install '.[yaml]'
scubadrift gate --results ScubaResults.json --exceptions exceptions.yaml
```

Both artifacts are **rebuilt on every deploy** from source (`tools/scubadrift/`),
so no fixed SHA-256 is published here. A versioned archive
(`scubadrift-<version>.zip`) is published alongside the `-latest` alias.

## Verifying a download

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\download.zip -Algorithm SHA256
# compare the output to the SHA-256 listed above before running
# then run the bundled test suite (where applicable):
#   pip install '.[dev]' ; pytest -q
```
